title: T-31 (player report 2026-11-13): other players hear a player's car horn. The horn rides the vehicle streams as a flag (VehicleEntry.Horn / VehicleDrivePayload.Horn) decided from the native horn source actually playing; a remote copy plays a horn source captured from the native horn before the strip; the owner plays a borrower's horn through its real car's native horn input. LEG 1: the host drives its own car and holds the GAME'S horn ('horn 2') - the client's copy starts, then stops on the off flag. LEG 2: the host leaves the car while the horn is held - the copy stops. LEG 3 (merger grant): the client drives the host's car and honks - the host plays it on its REAL car (captured horn source) and its fleet packet carries Horn=true, then both stop. Ends dissolved; NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1; both own cars). Dev build with the T-31 levers: horn <seconds> (holds input.Horn on the car this player drives via a CarController.Update postfix - the native sound path), hornstate (pick=<first own live car> own=[vid:ctl:src:playing:mod] copies=[vid:src:playing:clip]); plus the H-OWNERRIDE levers board/drive/ride/exitride and merge propose/accept/leave (a merger makes every partner car drivable).
